cover_headline: India On Track to Hit $1 Trillion in Exports This Year, Commerce Secretary Says
facts: Total exports in October rose 29.9% year-on-year to $89.99 billion, the highest monthly export value India has ever recorded
Goods exports alone hit an all-time monthly peak of $49.47 billion, a 45.06% jump from $34.11 billion a year earlier
Total exports during April-October 2026-27 reached an estimated $568.84 billion, up 16.66% from $487.59 billion in the same period last year

quote.text: We are on track to hit $1 trillion exports [of goods and services] this year.
quote.speaker: Rajesh Agrawal

end.headline: India On Track to Hit $1 Trillion in Exports This Year, Commerce Secretary Says
end.line: October exports hit a record $89.99 billion, with goods at a record $49.47 billion, against last fiscal's all-time high of $863 billion.
